Package org.lightsleep.connection

Class AbstractConnectionSupplier

java.lang.Object
org.lightsleep.connection.AbstractConnectionSupplier
All Implemented Interfaces:
Supplier<ConnectionWrapper>, ConnectionSupplier
Direct Known Subclasses:
C3p0, Dbcp, HikariCP, Jdbc, Jndi, TomcatCP
public abstract class AbstractConnectionSupplier extends Object implements ConnectionSupplier
An abstract class implementing the intersection of connection wrapper suppliers.
